reviewScope: Files durability/upload/HTTP authority and Hanlin/MiniApps ownership claims against ten exact integration source bodies and one already-held native status source

findings.filesDurabilityReceiptSeparation: No concrete contradiction: attachment 201 and Retry204 are acknowledged identities/requests, not content readback or cloud proof; inline/durable/cached remain distinct.
findings.uploadScope: One explicit attachment dispatch after reservation admission, original-scope retainReceipt precedes account/consumer/cancellation postflight, typed underlying errors and identity-only known receipt survive uncertainty.
findings.uploadDrain: AnyNativeFileUploadResponse.perform retains the owned task/session until both task completion and invalidation callbacks, with first pending result and no redirect/auth/body-stream replay paths.
findings.HTTP: Generic ordinary requests check account before/after and preserve mutation uncertainty on postflight failure; dedicated bound dispatch is separate and no ordinary-request atomic switch guarantee is established.
findings.Hanlin: Canonical router forwarding, mounted-owner original scope, current consent and post-await generation/engine marker checks, synchronous invalidation before async drain, and DEBUG-only full-message-save assembly match the read sources.
findings.MiniApps: Distinct revocation holds and generation fence, no automatic operation cancellation, consumer lease obligation, and pending target UTF8 identity/navigation-only completion match the read sources.

preciseScopeLimitations.topic: inflight is not a positive queue/transfer observation
preciseScopeLimitations.fact: Every non-inline row without NetworkSign defaults to inflight even when the queue is nil, the job is absent, or q.Get returns an error. A present job can refine attempts/last error/limited. The status alone does not positively establish an existing active or queued background operation.
preciseScopeLimitations.suggestedContractWording: Not yet durably signed or inline; this state alone does not prove an active/queued upload or cloud progress.

preciseScopeLimitations.fact: The checked marker is read.engineStartedAt against native.engineStartedAt, plus generation; it is not a direct comparison of AnyNativeAccountRunBinding.runID.
preciseScopeLimitations.suggestedContractWording: generation and exact engineStartedAt lease marker

preciseScopeLimitations.fact: A conflicting identity is refused while requestID is retained. didReachEditor removes its target/order state, so this queue supplies no durable completed-request replay tombstone or callback authentication.
preciseScopeLimitations.suggestedContractWording: Repeated URLs cannot replace a currently retained authenticated target; authentication and completed-request replay policy remain upstream.

preciseScopeLimitations.fact: The two-callback drain guarantee applies to the upload/info response owner. The generic client and bounded content-read helper do not implement that same invalidation barrier; no global transport-drain claim was accepted.
